Your  head line is joined to the line of life  and is   sloping  slightly  downwards.   It   indicates   highly sensitive  disposition  which inclines towards the  side  of caution and also lacks self confidence in materialism.  They rein  themselves in too tightly, and are always  inclined  to undervalue their capabilities and talents.  Since, this line tends  towards mount of Luna, you may develop a literary  or artistically hobby.

The brain line found in your palm has been  joined to  the line of life in the beginning and is forked  at  the termination point.  Therefore, you are of a highly sensitive disposition, which inclines towards the side of caution  and also lacks self confidence.  Rein yourself too tightly,  and are  always  inclined to undervalue  your  capabilities  and talents.  The forked mark often indicates a certain want  of decision.   Such  persons are inclined to balance  too  much between  the two qualities of brain, the practical  and  the imaginative.  As to say what you should do for the best,  it is  always wise to act according to first impulse either  in dealing  with practical or imaginative things.  By so  doing you employ, as it were, lthe intuition of the brain, and  by using  it do not waver and vacillate by too  much  reasoning over the question or endeavouring to see both sides of it at once.

Your  head line and heart line have conjoined  and have become one clear line running across the hand from side to  side.  This denotes tremendous intensity  of  character, for  good  or evil as the case may be; such a  person  would exhibit great power of concentration, and if he concentrated his  mentality  on any purpose he would unite  with  it  his heart nature.  But if he had set his heart or affections  on any person, he would unite with that desire the whole  force of  his  mental nature.  From material point of  view,  this line  can not be considered a favourable one.  They seem  to have no companions and for that reason always the feeling of being intensely lonely and isolated from others.  In  nature they  are sensitive land easily wounded in  their  feelings.  They  are  not  successful  in  partnerships  in   business, etc.rather should try to act alone; for the reason that they feel  their  personality cramped, and the partnership  as  a rule  seldom results happily.  Thus, denoting  an  intensely self concentrated nature.  If they love, they unite with  it all  the forces of their mind and soul into whatever it  may be.  Such people are head strong and self willed in all they do.  They do not seem to know what feat means in matters  of trifles  and  quarrels as they love trifling and  they  will stop  at  nothing if their blood is once  roused.   In  some cases,  it has been noticed that they are  either  extremely sensitive or have met with severe head accident.

Your head line is separated from the line of  life in  the  beginning and the space between them  is  not  very wide.   It is an excellent mark to have giving  independence of  thought,  quickness of judgement and  a  certain  mental daring that is invaluable in fighting the battle of life.

You  are  having the line of head  very  open  and separate  from  the line of life which denotes  a  character with  too little caution or sensitiveness rather  possessing over  confidence, away from reining themselves  too  tightly and  are always inclined to overestimate their  capabilities and  talents.  It also indicates excessive  impetuosity  and lack  of continuity of purpose, a person who pushes  himself forward on all occasions, a great desire for notoriety  land one  continually  changing  his plans  as far  as  world  is concerned.   The  brain seems to be an  extremely  excitable one.   In later years, may lsuffer from excessive  blood  to the  head,  sleeplessness  and all things  that  affect  the brain.

Your  line of brain joins to the line of  life  in the  beginning.   This  indicates  in  all  cases  a  highly sensitive  disposition, which inclines towards the  side  of caution  and  also  lacks  self-confidence,  seem  to   rein themselves  in  too  tightly  and  are  always  inclined  to undervalue your capabilities and talents.

Your brain line is commencing from inside the line of life.  This is most uncertain form.  It denotes an  over-sensitive, over-cautious person.  It also indicates a highly hervous,  easily  excited  individual, one  who  has  little control over himself or his temper,  who is easily put  over trifles,  and liable to do the most erratic things,  or  fly off at a tangent when irrigated.  Such people are always  in trouble, generally fighting or quarrelling with those  about them, and over things that are of no consequence.  They  are likewise  so easily wounded in their feelings, that  even  a look  or an imagined slight will put them out of  humour  or upset  them for days.  This tendency should be  checked  and controlled through remedial measures or will power else  new tendency  to seek temporarily relief through  medicines  may develop.

Your head line is separated from the line of  life in the beginning and at the same time lying fairly  straight across  the  palm. It is an excellent mark  to  have  giving independence  of  thought,  quickness  of  judgment  and  a certain  mental  daring that is invaluable in  fighting  the battle of life.  Such individuals have an immense power over themselves but their capabilities are always more distinctly shown  if  they should in any form go in for  some  kind  of public  life.   They have such brilliancy and  quickness  of thought  that they seem to see in a flash that which  takes the  other  people hard work to attain.   But  these  people must,  above  all things, have purpose in  their  life.   If without  any specific purpose, they are rather like  a  ship drifting on an idle sea.

Your brain line is joined to the line of life  and tends  to terminate towards the mount of upper  Mars.   This indicates  that  though  you  are  of  a  highly   sensitive disposition, which inclines towards the side of caution and also  lack self-confidence yet have got greater  courage  of his opinions.  With the advancement of age, they succeed  in controlling  this  sensitiveness  and  show  great  deal  of reliance to carry out your determination, and often, inspite of  being  sensitive or sometimes nervous, are  found  doing very  determined  work in connection with  some  battle  for principle or for right which you believe it your moral  duty to carry out.

Your  line  of fate appears to be stopped  by  the Line  of Head. It foretells that the career will be  spoiled by the person's wrong decisions or mental foolishness.

Your  Fate line is rising from the middle  of  the palm.  Such  natives  have a hard early life  and  that  the native must always have a hard fight to gain his ends.  They are  architects  of their own fortunes and without  help  or assistance  will  win  success  and  fortune  by  their  own personal hard work and merit.

Your  fate line is rising from the line  of  Head. The persons possessing such an indication attain  everything late in life and only then by their own brains. Such persons are  usually laborious, brain workers and are benefitted  in such like assignments.

Your  line  of fate is extremely faint or  just  barely traced through the palm.  It has been found to indicate a general disbelief  in  the  idea of fate and  destiny,  those  who  rebel against  any  power. However, by that time, they might  not  have defined their final career.

Your  line  of fate is extremely faint or  just  barely traced through the palm.  Either Path of Destiny has not yet been clearly  defined or such people, as a rule, lead very  colourless life, nothing seems to affect them one way or the other and  they will  be found to have very little purpose to illumine the  drab, monotony  or their existence.  They have to walk on iron road  in the run of their lives and face obstacles.  Luck does not  favour them.

Your  fate line is rising from the line  of  life. Success  will  be made by personal efforts  and  merit;  the early  years of such a Fate will be cramped  and  difficult; circumstances   and  the  early  surroundings   will   notbe favourable,  and  such people will be  greatly  hampered  or sacrified  to  the  wishes and plans  of  their  parents  or relatives.

Your  fate line is rising from the Mount  of  the Moon.  The  fate  of such persons  will  be  more  eventful, changeable, and largely depending on the fancy and  caprice of  other  people. It also foretells  happy  and  prosperous marriage,  but  one  in which idealism,  romance,  and  some fortunate  circumstances  play  their role,  and  one  which results more from the caprice or fancy of the person of  the other sex.

Your  fate line is joining the line of  heart  and they together ascend the Mount of Jupiter. Such persons will be happy through their affections and will be helped by love and affection to attain their highest ambitions . They  will also  be extremely lucky through the friendship and love  of those they meet and will be greatly benefited and helped  by others.

The  Great Triangle formed by the lines  of  Head, Life and Health is larger and is well formed which indicates that the person will enjoy better health.  His views of life will also be broader and the field of action as it were less limited.

The  Great Triangle formed by the lines  of  Head, 
Life  and  Health  is acute and is  not  well  formed  which 
indicates that the person may not enjoy better health.   His 
views will be limited or over-disciplined.  Sometimes he may 
be more nervous, timid and sensitive.

The Girdle of Venus, made up of little pieces,  is present  in your palm (though not in full form).   It  makes the  native hyper-sensitive, especially in matters  relating to  mental  love  and  mental sex.   It  show  a  hysterical temperament.   These persons in all cases suffer  enormously from moods, they are very difficult to live with.

Your  line of heart is beginning from the  outside of  the Mount of Jupiter, it shows the blind  enthusiast  in affection,  a  person who places his ideal of love  so  high that  neither  fault  nor  failing  is  seen  in  the  being worshipped.  With these people their pride in the object  of their  affection  is  beyond  all  reason,   and  all   such extremists   as  a  rule  suffer  terribly   through   their affections.

Your  line of heart is arising from the centre  of the Mount of Jupiter.  Therefore, you are firm and  reliable in  your  affections.  You have an unusually  high  code  of honor and morality.  You are ambitious that the person they live with be great, noble and successful.  You seldom  marry beneath  your  station  in life, and  you  have  fewer  love affairs than any other class.  If you once really love,  you love  for ever.  People with such a line do not  believe  in second marriages and the divorce courts are seldom troubled.

Your  heart  line is arising from  the  first  and second fingers giving a calmer but a very deep nature in all matters of the affections.  These people seem to strike  the happy  medium between the ideality and pride.  They are  not very  demonstrative when in love, but they are capable  of the very greatest sacrifices for those they care for.   They do  not  expect  the  person  on  whom  they  bestow   their affections to be a god or goddess.

Your  line of heart rises on the Mount of  Saturn.  This  does  not  denote generosity in  matters  relating  to affections.   Such persons are not  self-sacrificing  rather reserved,  undemonstrative  in love matters,  but  are  very insistent in trying to gain the person they want.  They will let nothing stand in their way, but once they have  attained their object they show little tenderness or devotion.   They are very unforgiving if they discover any lapse on the  part of  their partner, but as they are "a law unto  themselves", they close their eyes to their own shortcomings.  As such  , the personality is less sentimental.

Your  line of heart is found curving  downward  at the  base of the Mount of Jupiter which tells of  a  strange fatality   in   that   person,   of   meeting   with   great disappointment  in love, and even with those they  trust  in friendship.   They seem to lack perception, in knowing  whom to  love.  Their affections are nearly always  misplaced  or never returned.  They have, however, as a rule,  wonderfully kind,  affectionate  dispositions.  They have  little  pride about whom they love and they generally marry beneath  their station in life.

You   are   possessing   almost   conic   hand.   The   main characteristics of the conic hand are art, impulse and  instinct, but  one in which love of luxury indolence predominate the  great fault  with the people possessing this type is that  though  they may  be  clever and quick in thought and ideas yet  they  are  so utterly  devoid of patience and tire so easily that they  rarely, if  ever, carry out their intention. Such people appear to  their greatest advantage in company or before strangers. They are  good conversationalists.  They  grasp the drift of the subject  quickly, but  they are more or less superficial in knowledge and  also  in other things, because they lack application and reasoning  rather judge by impulse and instinct. That is why this duality makes them changeable  in  friendship and affection. They are  sensitive  to their  surroundings.   Their likes and dislikes  are  remarkable. They  are quick tampered but momentarily though plainly  and  are generous  and sympathetic.  They are more easily  influenced  by colour music, eloquence, tears, joy or sorrow than any other type. They are emotional.

You  are possessing somewhat elementary type  of  hand. Such natives are violent in nature, and have little or no  control over  their  passions or their anger.  They are coarse  in  their ideas, possess little or no sentiment, no imagination or feeling, lack  love of form, colour and beauty and it has been found  that even the nerve system of such types is more or less in a state of non-development.  They are laborious in physical sense.
Idealistic or Psyshic Hand

Mercury  line  has  been found to be  in  the  best possible formation on your palm.  It denotes robust,  strong constitution and a healthy state of the nervous system.  If, however,  constitution  may not be robust, it  is  wiry  and there is great reserve resistance to disease.

Mercury  line  has been found tobe in  the  weaker formation  on  your palm.  It does not  promise  robust,  or strong constitution or healthy state of the nervous  system.  If,  however, constitution is robust, it is lacking  reserve resistance to disease.
Mercury  line  has been missing  from  your  palm.  This  is an auspicious point because its absence  denotes  a robust,  strong  constitution, and a healthy  state  of  the nervous system.

You  are  possessing mixed type of hand which  is  most difficult  of all to describe.  As is the name, this is the  hand of  ideas,  of  versatility and  generally  of  changeability  of purpose.   Such  a  person  is  adaptable  to  both  people   and circumstances,  clever,  but erratic in the  application  of  his talents.   He will be brilliant in conversation, by  the  subject science, art or gossip.  He may play some instrument fairly well, may  paint a little, and so on.  Such hands find  their  greatest scope  in  work  requiring  diplomacy  and  tact.   They  are  so versatile  that  they have no difficulty in getting on  with  the different dispositions with which they come into contact.   Their most striking peculiarity is their adaptability to circumstances; they rarely feel the ups and downs of fortune like others.   They are  laborious but do not stick to one cause.  They are  restless and  do  not  remain long in any  particular  place.   They  like newness in all things and life itself.

You  are  possessing  long and angular  with  bony  fingers, developed  joints  and long nails which is  called  philosophical hand. As far as success in the form of wealth is concerned, it is not a favourable type to have. It gleans wisdom rarely, if  ever, gold.  People  with such a type are, as a rule, students  but  of peculiar subjects. They study mankind; they know every chord  and tone  in the harp of life; they play upon it, and  are  gratified with  its responsive melody more than with the clink of coin.  In this  way they have as much ambition as other types  of  humanity only theirs is of a different kind , that is all. They like to be distinct from other people and they will go through all kinds  of privations  to attain this end; but as knowledge gives  power  so does  the knowledge of mankind give power over man.  Such  people love  mystery  in all things. In character they  are  silent  and secretive;  they are deep thinkers careful over  little  matters, even in the use of little words; they are proud with the pride of being  different from others, they rarely forget an  injury,  but they  are  patient  with the patience of  power;  they  wait  for opportunities,  so  opportunities  serve  them.  Such  hands  are generally  egoistical,  which is in keeping with  the  life  they lead.  However, they should try to control; to some extent  their habit  of unnecessary going in detail of things or  fanatism,  in mysticism . Anyhow they are distinct from others.

You are possessing almost a square hand. Such a type of hand is  also called the useful, because it is found in so many  walks of life. People with such a hand are orderly punctual and precise in  manners,  not however, from any innate grace of  nature,  but more  from  conformity  with  custom  and  habit.  They   respect authority, they love discipline, they have a place for everything and everything is kept in its place, not only in their household, but in their brains. They respect law and order and are slaves to custom;   they  are  not  quarrelsome  but  are   determined   in opposition, they prefer to reason to instinct, peace to war,  and are methodical in work and in habit, They are endowed with  great perseverance,  but  are  tenacious not  resigned;  they  are  not enthusiastic  over imaginative arts: they ask for  the  material, they  win success in practical things in religion, they will  not goto extremes; they prefer substance to show and dogma to  ideas. They are not adaptable to people, or versatile; they have  little originality,  or  imagination,  but  in  work  they  have   great application, force of character, strength of will, and often  out disntance   their  more  brilliant  and  talented  rivals.   They naturally love the exact sciences and all practical studies. They love  home  and the duties of home but are not  demonstrative  in attraction.  They  are sincere and true in promises.  Staunch  in friendship,  strong  in principle, and honest in  business.  They should exercise their control over being inclined to reason by  a twelve inch rule, and disbelieve all they cannot understand.

You  are  possessing  somewhat  speculate  hand  though  not exactly. Therefore, as a result of the same you are restless  and excitable,  but  full of energy of purpose and  enthusiasm.  Such people   have   their  intense  love  of   action,   energy   and independence.  This  type  of hand belongs  to  the  great  field workers,   engineers,  mechanics,  discoverers  navigators   i.e. outdoor life full of adventures. The most striking characteristic of  all is the sigular independence of spirit that  characterises individuals, possessing such a development. It is doubtless, this spirit  that makes them fashion designers or explorers  in  every sense of the word. They have an original way of looking at things and their sense of indenpendence inclines them to resent  suiting their brain to other peoples' idea.

Detailed analysis of your mental attitude, emotional   side   of  temperament,   health,   recognition, partnership,  career and of other characteristics  is  given hereunder:

Life  line on your palm is long,  clearly  marked, and  without  any  major  irregularities  or  breaks.   This indicates enough resistance power against diseases and  good condition  of  vital organs of body.   This  also  indicates length of life, vitality, freedom from illness, and strength of constitution.

Life line on your palm is weakly marked and is not long  and  clearly marked without any  irregularities.  This does not promise resistance power against diseases and  good condition  of vital organs of body.  This  hampers  vitality and as such, does not make the native free from illness, and weaken  the constitution, especially during childhood  or  in old age.

One branch of your life line is ascending  towards the Mount of Guru which indicates the desire and ambition to rise  in  life, especially in some way that would  give  the native control or authority over others.

Your life line is terminating towards the Mount of Venus  and  the encircled area is wide.  It  indicates  that such  persons  are romantic, showing a greater  tendency  to fall in love, and attachment with native land.

Your life line is terminating towards the Mount of Moon and the encircled area is shortened.  It indicates that such  persons  are  restless in nature,  showing  a  greater tendency  to fall in love, and are keen in being  always  on the  move.   They are great traveler than  ordinary  person travels in his lifespan.

Your marriage line is almost normal in your  palm.  This  indicates  that  marriage will take  place  timely  in accordance with your family tradition and married life  will be  harmonious.   Your  partner will not leave  you  in  the lurch.

Your  marriage  line on the palm  is  not  clearly and  appropriately marked.  This is an indicative of  either delayed  or disharmonious conjugal life.   Misunderstandings may take place either before marriage or after marriage.  As such  this is a sign of trouble and anxiety in  the  married life either due to nature or ill health of the partner.

You are having two parallel marriage lines on your palm.   This sign  does not indicate two marriages,  as  is generally   supposed  by  many  palmists.    But delay   or disharmonious conjugal life is indicated.
Your  line  of  marriage is  curving  or  dropping downward  toward  the line of heart, it foretells  that  the person  with  whom the subject is married is liable  to  die first.

There is unfulfilled Ring of Solomon in your palm.  This  is  a strange mark of mysticism  and  occultism.   Its possessor  will  aim at having the power of a master  or  an adept in such subjects.

There  are tracings of Ring of Saturn (though  not fully  formed) in your palm.  This is inauspicious  sign  to have  on one's hand which is indicative of numerous  hurdles in  carrying  out one's plans to a  successful  termination.  These people seem cut off from their fellow beings in  some peculiar  and  extraordinary  way.  They  are  isolated  and alone,  and they appear to realize lonely  position  keenly.  They  are gloomy, morbid and rarely meet with  partners  who understand  them. You  possess  normal sun line on your  palm.   This  is indicative  of more magnetism, more influence over others.   Such persons  easily secure recognition, reward, riches  and  honors.  They  also have a happier and brighter disposition, and this  has naturally  a  great deal to do with what is called  success.  The nature of such people is much more sensitive to environment  than normal.  They love beautiful things, harmony of surroundings, e.g. they  are choosy in colors of curtains whether these are  black, green, yellow or some fearful conglomeration of all three.

Your  line of sun is starting from line of  heart.   It gives  success late in life someway depending on, or through  the affections.   In  such  cases, this is also  promises  a  delayed happiness  in  married  life  and is a  sign  of  eventual  ease, happiness and worldly comfort.

You are possessing clubbed thumb.  Such persons do 

not  depend  upon their will power and are known  for  their 

unreasonable  obstinacy on whatever matter they  take  stand 

and if they are opposed they fly into ungovernable  passions 

and blind rages.  Then they have no control over themselves.  

They generally do not plan out or premeditate an action, for 

they lack determined will or power of reason to think it out 

in  advance.   They are advised not to  take  important  and 

judicious decisions in the impulse of action or singularily.

You  are  having  firm  joined  thumb.   As  such,  the qualities  earmarked predominantly are - to grasp, grab, hold  or retain  in  every  sense  of  the  word.   They  do  not  respond impulsively  rather  demands reflection before he even  gives  an opinion.  Such persons are  of more resisting nature and are more likely  to  refuse  at first and on reflection to  agree  to  the proposition;  but if he does make up his mind, he will  stick  to his  judgment  or opinion and the more he is  opposed  the  more determined he will be to hold to his view. They do not enter into conversations with strangers.
You  are having travel line on your palm.   This  tells that  such  persons  are  restless in  nature.   They  are  great traveler on the globe.  Are always on the move, less settled  in life.
